Name: Gad
Summary: Gad was the seventh son of Jacob, the first by Zilpah, and the father of Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
KeyStory: Gad's tribe later settled east of the Jordan and became known as warriors, just as Jacob had blessed him.
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Zilpah; Ziphion; Haggi; Shuni; Ezbon; Eri; Arodi; Areli
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
